prs.title: Gracefully terminate active sessions during StreamableHTTP shutdown
prs.author: Bortlesboat
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed during shutdown, causing EventSourceResponse coroutines to be cancelled mid-stream and Uvicorn to log ASGI incomplete-response errors. Both PRs add the same fix: iterate `_sse_stream_writers` in `terminate()` and close/clear them, plus a graceful session-termination loop in the manager's lifespan `finally` block. (2 PRs)

Both diffs touch the same two files with near-identical logic, but #2259's guard makes the fix safer under concurrent shutdown scenarios.

members.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1531 addresses the root cause at the request layer by adding `Accept: application/json` to both `_exchange_token` and `_refresh_token` (covering both flows), and includes test coverage. PR #1511 takes the complementary approach of parsing URL-encoded responses defensively, but its diff is truncated mid-implementation (`if content_ty` is cut off) and adds significant complexity. The standard OAuth 2.0 fix is to explicitly negotiate JSON via Accept headers as #1531 does; the response-parsing fallback in #1511 could be folded into #1531 if needed for servers that ignore the Accept header.

clusters.pick_reason: #2259 includes an idempotency guard (`if self._terminated: return`) that #2253 omits, preventing double-termination races. #2259 also skips the `# pragma: no cover` annotation on the new SSE-writer loop, suggesting the path is reachable in tests, while #2253 marks it no-cover. Both diffs touch the same two files with near-identical logic, but #2259's guard makes the fix safer under concurrent shutdown scenarios.

members.title: fix: terminate active StreamableHTTP sessions during shutdown
members.author: weiguangli-io
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2259: Active SSE stream writers are not closed during shutdown, causing EventSourceResponse coroutines to be cancelled mid-stream and Uvicorn to log ASGI incomplete-response errors. Both PRs add the same fix: iterate `_sse_stream_writers` in `terminate()` and close/clear them, plus a graceful session-termination loop in the manager's lifespan `finally` block.
